title: Category
content: **Objective** Manage the Category of your Content. Customize the field names to match your workflow. 1. What is Category? 2. Category by Content 3. Category Multi-select 4. Category Settings 5. Filter by Category # **Details** ### 1) What is Category? * CLO-SET 'Category' is a customizable field that helps identify the Content, as well as filter the Content for a faster search. * Best Practice: * We recommend using the Category field for unique terms/labels for your team. * ex) 'Basic' line, 'Boyfriend' line, / 'Sunshine Orange', 'Midnight Blue', etc. * For generic terms, CLO-SET [AI-Search](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303182799641) will detect it for you. ![check+shirring+back+womens+swimsuit_Colorway](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777988210841) | ► | ![cat:tag2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778003660185) ---|---|--- ### 2) Category by Content * Identify the Category of each Content. * Editors or above can make changes. * Fields are customizable by Company Admin or above in [Company Settings](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002215416) page. ![Screenshot 2023-10-24 at 9.46.09 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777988508185) ### 3) Category Multi-select * In your Workroom, select the Content(s). * From the multi selection bar above, click 'Category' ![Screenshot 2023-10-20 at 9.54.26 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778004083097) * Select the Category to be applied to selected Contents.* * Please note that the pre-existing categories of each Content will be overwritten. ![Screenshot 2023-10-20 at 9.55.41 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777974212633) ### 4) Category Settings * Category fields are customizable in [Company Settings](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002215416) page. * You may add up to 4 depths of Category. ![Category.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778004362649) * The **View Options** toggle in the Category tab allows to choose between two display modes for how category information appears on the Content Page. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52576304797849) 1. Last Depth (Default) Displays only the final (deepest) category level selected for the content. This option keeps the category display concise and minimal. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52952048613785) 2\. Full Depth Displays the entire hierarchy of the selected category—from the top level to the final depth—within the Content Page information. This option provides full visibility into the category structure. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52952002283033) ### 5) Filter by Category ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 10.16.15 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777974559001) ![Screenshot 2023-10-24 at 11.38.57 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778004637977) Search faster by filtering the Category. Filters are available on the [Search tab](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303160683161) OR in [Workrooms](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303240419865).

title: CLO-SET Thumbnail
content:
#### Content: Applicable to Content uploaded or updated on March 12th, 2024 and onward, or PDF files uploaded on July 9th, 2024 and onward. # **Objective** Understand the Thumbnail types and rules in CLO-SET. 1. Default Colorway 2. Custom View 3. Thumbnail Types & Rules 4. Thumbnail Change 5. PDF Thumbnail # **Details** CLO-SET offers two different thumbnail options of content. When uploading 3D files to CLO-SET, users can select either the "**Default Colorway"** or the **"Custom View"** option. ### ### **1) Default Colorway** **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778235562649)** * CLO-SET Thumbnails are created based on the original file. Starting Mar 2024, CLO-SET thumbnails will be synced with the Default Colorway in CLO3D. * '**Deafult Colorway** ' is the selected Colorway at the time of saving the file in CLO3D. * To change the 'Deafult Colorway' used in CLO-SET, you may upload a new Version or 'Create New Version' ### **2) Custom View** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47592686255641) * Custom View is a function in CLO3D that allows you to save a certain Viewpoint. CLO-SET, supports thumbnail images and turntable images based on the Custom View. Link to set [Custom View](https://clo3d.zendesk.com/knowledge/editor/01JWB42WYFJTD6VSN6JS0ECPJP/en-us?brand_id=44407677825689&section_id=44750293195417) in CLO-SET. > 💡 **Note:** Custom View is available only for .**zprj files** as the Custom View data is only
> > saved for **.zprj file** > 💡 **Note:** Custom View is applied to anywhere utilizing thumbnail features, including
> > **Linesheet** , **Visual Board** , **Web Tech Pack** and any other thumbnails in CLO-SET. ### **3) Thumbnail Types & Rules** * ### Content Page There are 3 types of Thumbnail images on the Content Page. **[Important]** Beginning March 2024, all Thumbnails within the Content Page will be based on the Default Colorway of the uploaded file. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778259295897) ![thumbnail2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778270784025) * ### Workroom View **[Important]** Beginning March 2024, Workroom Thumbnail and Turntable will be based on the Default Colorway of the original file. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778250198553) ![thumbnail3.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778286596121) * ### Assortment **[Important]** Beginning March 2024, Assortment Thumbnail will be based on the Default Colorway of latest version at the time Content was moved to the Assortment. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778286769689) ![thumbnail4.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778260286489) ### 3) Thumbnail Changes * ### Change Thumbnail * Thumbnail in Content Information tab * Thumbnail in Workroom view * Turntable will NOT be updated ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778287073433) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778251183641) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778287393561) * ### Version Update * Uploading a new [Version](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303241367961) will auto-update the Thumbnails in Content Page and Workroom. * To avoid the changes in Thumbnail, please activate 'Keep the current Thumbnail' option. ![Group 134.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47592686257817) * ### Create New Version * Creating a New Version will update all Thumbnails in Content Page & Workroom View. * Selected Colorway at the time of creating the new Version will replace the 'Default Colorway' ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778272699801). ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778294849945) * ### Delete Latest Version * * Deleting the Latest Version will NOT update the Thumbnails shown in Workroom or Content Page - Information tab. Thumbnail from the deleted version will be displayed. To change the Thumbnail, please upload a new Version or Create New Version. ### 4) PDF Thumbnail * When uploading a PDF file as a new Content or Version, CLO-SET will create a thumbnail based on the cover page of the uploaded PDF file. * Users can click the 'PDF preview' button on the viewer to load the preview of the full document. * If the 'keep current thumbnail' option is enabled, Thumbnail will not be updated on Content Info tab and Workroom page. * If the file is too large or cannot be opened due to error, a PDF icon will be displayed instead. * * Content Page Thumbnail (PDF) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778273168537) * * Workroom Thumbnail (PDF) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778295266329) > 💡 **Note:** Thumbnails on the Content Page can now be viewed in full screen. By clicking the **expand icon** located beneath the thumbnail, a new window will open, allowing to view a larger, clearer version of the image. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52576376979097) ### **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52576376984473)** ###

content: # **📝 List of Contents** 📍CLO-SET provides multiple options to help with the data management, including Category, Workflow, Tag, and Content Fields. title: Render
content: # **Objective** You can render the images on the 3D Viewer in the content page. Check real-time rendering progress and download the rendered file by clicking ![mceclip3.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778675651993) icon on the Content page. * Update in Render Settings (Feb 2024) 1. Render - How To 2. Crop Option in Render Setting 3. Rendering Server Status 4. Render Preset 5. Render in CLO vs CLO-SET # **Details** ### • Update in Render Settings (Feb 2024) The **default** **background setting** has been updated to match your Render Settings in CLO3D. You may choose to disable the option to customize the Render background in CLO-SET. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778722895257) ### 1) Render - How To ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778692305689) 1\. Click ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778676417177) (Render) icon on the left pane of the Content page. 2\. It will lead you to 'Rendering Settings' where you can set the Colorway, Type, Image Size, Background, and Quality of rendered images. 3\. After the setting, click 'Render' button to start rendering. *Please note that the maximum image size is 5000px. *For Turntable images, maximum image count on CLO-SET is 64. ## ### 2) Crop Option in Rendering Setting * crops to the nearest 5 pixels of the 3D content,_regardless of what is shown in the 3D Viewer_ * works both in transparent and colored background * Style Page > Render > Rendering Settings > Background > Crop * You must uncheck the 'Use Software settings' before applying the Crop option ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778676720025) In order to properly use the 'Crop' option, **the 3D content needs to be placed within the darkened frame shown inside the 3D Viewer.** ![crop.gif](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778739645465) Although the darkened frame does not reflect the cropped frame when the Crop option in clicked, _the 3D content is first cropped by the darkened frame_. Thus, if the 3D Content sits outside of the darkened frame, the render will be cropped. For example, if the render is triggered as shown below on the left, the result will be as the following on the right. ![Screenshot_2023-01-27_at_9.15.27_AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778709349145) | ► | ![Reflective_Jogger_and_Crop_Top_Closet_Library_Fabric__Colorway_A_0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778724565657) ---|---|--- Final Render output shown below. ![Reflective_Jogger_and_Crop_Top_Closet_Library_Fabric__Colorway_A_2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778694043673) ![Reflective_Jogger_and_Crop_Top_Closet_Library_Fabric__Colorway_A_3.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778740992665) ![Reflective_Jogger_and_Crop_Top_Closet_Library_Fabric__Colorway_A_0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778678578073) ![Reflective_Jogger_and_Crop_Top_Closet_Library_Fabric__Colorway_A_1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778694926361) ### 3) Rendering Server Status 'CLO-SET Rendering Server Status' is a feature that allows users to be more aware of their rendering status with the information of server status and their current orders in the rendering queues. Find out more details on [THIS ARTICLE](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303263040921). ### 4) Render Preset For a unified Render output, you may upload a Render Preset for your Company members. Find out more [here](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129). ### 5) Render in CLO vs CLO-SET Basically, V-Ray's CPU and GPU rendering don't produce identical results. CLO and CLO-SET both use [Vray Rendering.](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115003861567-V-Ray-Render) However, CLO-SET only supports GPU rendering, whereas CLO supports both GPU and CPU rendering. The results of the GPU render of CLO and the render of CLO-SET are consistent. But, as CPU and GPU rendering results differ, you cannot expect to see the same results between the CLO CPU and CLO-SET GPU rendering results. We suggest the following workflow. Select the device before starting the rendering task and generate the final output. Choose either one of the workflow. > Utilizing GPU rendering in CLO and CLO-SET. > Utilizing CPU rendering in CLO. Unfortunately, attempting to synchronize the CPU and GPU is impossible.
content_description: This webpage provides comprehensive guidance on using the 3D Viewer for real-time image rendering, including updates on render settings, cropping options, server status, and differences between CLO and CLO-SET rendering.

title: Supported File Formats in 3D Viewer
content: # **Objective** Learn about supported file formats in CLO-SET 3D Viewer. 1. [File Format](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153968537) 2. Using 3D Viewer # **Details** ### 1) File Format **Type** | **Format** | **Description** ---|---|--- Garment | *.zpac | Contains information on garments, patterns, sewing, and fabrics. Project | *.zprj | Compressed version of multiple files used for garment creation. The Project file contains the AVT file that has avatar-related data (Avatar, Accessories, Arrangement Bounding Volumes, Arrangement Points, Avatar size, Poses), the ZPac file that contains garment-related data (3D Garments, 2D Patterns, Fabrics, subsidiary Material), as well as an animation file if there is any. Avatar | *.avt, .avte | Contains all the information related to Avatars (Model, Sizing data, Poses, Motions, Accessories, Bounding Volumes, Arrangement Points). OBJ | *.obj | Contains geometry and material information. Primarily used for importing avatar and related sources into the program. GL Transmission Format | *gltf / glb | Contains scene and material information using the JSON standard. Primarily used for importing avatar and related sources into the program. COLLADA | *.dae | This file can be exported from other 3D softwares such as 3ds Max, Maya, Pose, and DAZ Studio. These files contain geometry and material information, as well as rigging, skinning, and animation data When exporting COLLADA files from 3ds Max or Maya, install “OpenCOLLADA plugin (<http://www.opencollada.org/download.html>) and export to use the avatar Fabric | *.zfab | Contains the property values (texture + physical properties) of the set fabric. Button | *.btn | Contains the type, size, and color of Buttons. Buttonhole | *.bth | Contains the type, size, and color of the Buttonholes. Trim | *.trm | Contains material information Zipper Puller | *.zpl | Contains the type, size, and color of Zipper Pullers. Zipper Slider | *.zsd | Contains the type, size, and color of Zipper Sliders. Zipper Stopper | *.zsp | Contains the type, size, and color of Zipper Stoppers. ### * Additional Supported File : DXF ### 2) Using 3D Viewer For more instructions on how to use CLO-SET 3D Viewer, click [HERE](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153968537).
content_description: Explore the supported file formats for CLO-SET 3D Viewer to optimize your garment design experience.

title: 3D Quality Check
content: #### Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776222318873)Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776264545305)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776271079833)Editor #### Compatibility: Supported for 3D files. Find the detailed file format list here. # # **Updates** 3D Quality Check allows you to check the properties of the CLO file in CLO-SET. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776274210073) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776271643417) ---|--- 1. What it Quality Check? 2. Setup Quality Check 3. Quality Check in Content Page 4. Quality Check Results 5. Supported File Formats 6. Setup Guide PDF (ENG) # **Details** ### 1) What is 3D Quality Check? * CLO-SET Quality check allows teams to automize the QC process of the CLO files. CLO-SET will automatically check the uploaded CLO file properties per the standards setup by the Admin and mark the result for the team to view. * Quality Check standards can be set for each Company within the Group. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776271792665) ### 2) Setup Quality Check **Permission** : ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776222318873) Group Admin, Company Admin * To start using the feature, your Company must have a 3D Quality Check standards setup by the Admin. This can be done on the [Company Settings](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/articles/45303214894873) page. * In Company Settings, click Content > 3D Quality Check. Then, click the activate toggle. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776272087961) * For more details on how to input the properties and what each property refers to in CLO, please[ download the PDF guideline.](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/49715354278809) [![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776275644441)](https://support.clo-set.com/guide-media/01JR7CPDFB3DKX4HT02CFREMYD) | [![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776283678233)](https://support.clo-set.com/guide-media/01JR7CPDFB3DKX4HT02CFREMYD) ---|--- * **Please note** : updating the properties will NOT be synced to older tests. You must re-upload the file to apply the new standards. ### 3) Quality Check in Content Page Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776222318873)Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776264545305)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776271079833)Editor ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776274210073) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776271643417) ---|--- * Once the Quality Check is activated and setup, it will be applied to the newly uploaded files. * Click the red 'QC' icon next to the version name to view the full test result. * **Please Note** : Quality Check runs only once for all versions. Re-upload the file to run the quality check again. * The 'QC' label will be displayed on the latest version uploaded. To review the QC for older versions, click the ••• menu and select '3D Quality Check' option as displayed below. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776324372377) ### ### 4) Quality Check Results Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776222318873)Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776264545305)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776271079833)Editor * A new tab will open with the full test result. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776292991001) * 1. 1. Category of the property 2. Property setup in Company Settings 3. Criteria setup in Company Settings 4. Test result: Passed 5. Test result: Failed, click the list icon for the list of materials that failed the test 6. Test result: N/A. Property not included in the checklist 7. Select to only view the properties that failed the test * * **Please note** : Updating or editing the 3D file should be done in CLO. Also, Quality Check runs only once for all versions. Re-upload the file to run the quality check again. ### 5) Supported File Formats * Compatible with all file types supported in 3D Viewer, as of Dec 2024. * More specifically, 3D Quality Check is compatible with the file extensions listed below: * zpac, zprj, avt, obj, fbx, dae, glb, grp, zfab, zmod, trm, btn, bth, zpl, zsd, zse, zsp, zpu, zsl, zst, zss, sst, zacs, pos, hpos
content_description: This webpage provides detailed guidance on the 3D Quality Check feature in CLO-SET, enabling users to automate the quality control process for CLO files and ensure compliance with company standards.

title: Console - Data Intelligence
content: #### Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778936912793) Group Admin, Group Operator # **Objective** ![Shape \(2\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778937118489) | Access Admin Console by clicking ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778959663897) icon on your CLO-SET dashboard. Admin Console shows the Group summary, Billing, Data Intelligence, Activity Log, Settings, and Developer Page. ---|--- On the Data Intelligence tab, you may review details on your user activity and Content. 1. User Activity 2. Content * Total Color Composition Rate * Trends Chart * Scatter Chart 3. Leadtime 4. Cost Saving # **Details** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123313987481) **Menu** | **Sub-Menu** | **Details** ---|---|--- Data Intelligence | * User Activity * Content * Leadtime * Cost Saving | View usage statistics per user, including content views and rendering usage. In addition, view Color analytics of your Contents. Leadtime and Cost Saving analysis shows the workflow efficiency and potential sample cost savings ### 1) User Activity ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778932244889) 1. Filter the time period to view 2. Filter the type of users to view * Active users are anyone with more at least 1 count of the measured values. * Inactive users are those who did not use any of the counted values. 3. Search specific users with their registered name or email to view their usage 4. Name and Email of the user. Users who have been deleted from the Group and no longer have permission will be greyed out. 5. Click on the field to sort - either in ascending or descending order ### 2) Content ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 5.01.22 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778951263897) * Filter the Date & Workroom you want to view * For Group Operators, the 'Space' filter will only display the list of Spaces to which they have Viewer or above permission to. Group Admin can select any Space within the Group. * Total Style Contents: Total number of Contents uploaded during the date range, and included in the statistics shown below. This covers ONLY the Contents you have viewing permission to. * Average Used Colors: Average number of Colors used per Style Content * Total Fabric Colors: Total number of Fabric Color used within the selected Space *ONLY Applicable to any Content uploaded on March, 2023 and onward. #### **1\. Total Color Composition Rate** ![Total_Color_Composition_Rate.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778951412633) The Doughnut Chart on the left shows the distribution of Primary Colors used for the Style Contents. Hover over the Color to view the details. On the right hand table, click on each Primary Color to view all the related Original Colors. * Primary Color: Main Color(Hex/Pantone) with the highest usage rate among similar color group * Original Color: All unique Colors used. Grouped by Primary Color. *Color usage rate is calculated based on the fabric size #### **2\. Trends Chart**![Period](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778983106073) Trends Chart shows the number of Style Content that used the top 10 Primary Colors over time. You may view the Color Trend chronically. Change the chart type to _Bar or Line_ , or change period to _Week or Year_ to change the view. Bar Chart ![BarChart.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778938710041) | Line Chart ![ColorTrend.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778938989849) ---|--- #### #### **3\. Scatter Chart** ![Color](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778939302809) Scatter Chart visualizes the Saturation/Brightness of the Colors used. Click on the Primary Color to view the Original Colors included in the group. * **X-axis** : Hue (Color Spectrum of 0~360) * **Y-axis** : Saturation or Brightness per your selection. Click on the upper left dropdown button to switch the view. * **Marker Size:** Number of Style Contents that used the selected Color. ### 3) Leadtime ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50834306994073)Leadtime Analysis shows the workflow efficiency with a clear **summary of lead times** , **completion trends** , and the **current status of all contents** in their Workroom. 1. Summary : Displays the total content and overall lead time at the top. * Total Style Content : The total amount of style content in the space (or selected space) 2. Average Leadtime : Displays the average time it takes for content to move through each workflow step, based on the applied filters. 3. Average Spent time : Displays the average time spent at each workflow step for the filtered contents in a Space. 4. Style List : Lists the current lead times for all Style contents in the Workroom. 5. Export : Lead time analysis data on the screen can be exported to PDF. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123313998745) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123314002201) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123314005657) ---|--- Visit Leadtime menu of Data Intelligence, select the 'space' and 'category' to see the analysis. * The Space option is only visible when a user with admin permission accesses the Admin Console. * The analysis data is updated and displayed based on the previous day. > **_Items uploaded after April 2025 with no workflow status changes may be excluded from the list._** ### 4) Cost Saving ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123610837785) Cost Saving Analysis shows the**potential sample cost savings** across all Style contents in Workrooms. The savings are calculated based on the **number of versions** and **colorways per style** , multiplied by a **sampling cost** defined by the user. 1. Summary : Displays the total styles, colorways, default sample cost and total saving cost at the top. * Total Style : Total number of contents with ‘Style’ content type. * Total Colorway : Total number of digital sample versions created across styles. * Default Sample Cost : Default sampling cost to estimate the total saving cost. * Total Saving Cost : Sum of estimated savings across all styles, calculated by: Total Colorways × Sampling Cost (per style) 2. Colorways per workflow : Displays the total number of colorways at each workflow status. 3. Sample Saving Cost per Content : Displays Each style’s saving is calculated as: colrway x Sampling Cost (per style) 4. Export : Cost saving analysis data on the screen can be exported to PDF. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123314013849) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123314002201) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123314005657) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123314015769) ---|---|--- Visit Cost Saving Analysis menu of Data Intelligence, select the 'space' , 'category' and 'workflow' to see the cost analysis. * The Space option is only visible when a user with admin permission accesses the Admin Console. * The analysis data is updated and displayed based on the previous day. > **_Items uploaded after April 2025 with no workflow status changes may be excluded from the list._**
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to guide Group Admins and Operators in accessing and utilizing the Admin Console for comprehensive data intelligence, including user activity, content analytics, lead time tracking, and cost-saving evaluations.

title: Change Plan / Unsubscribe
content: # **Objective** Learn how to cancel your Advanced Plan subscription and downgrade to free plan. 1. Change Plan * Upgrade * Downgrade (Unsubscribe) 2. Refund Policy *Before you start: Plan type can only be managed by[ Group Admin or Group Operator](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537). Changing your plan type will affect everyone in your [Group](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985). # **Details** ### 1) Change Plan * To change your plan type, visit [Console - Summary](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303236765721). * Make sure you are in the correct Group. Check the Group name on the top-left corner of your screen. To switch Groups, click on the downward arrow (⌄) next to the Group name. * Click 'Change Plan' on the right to select a new plan. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778328362905) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778328565657) ---|--- ### ⬆️ Upgrade Upgrading will take place **immediately** after the payment is made. 1\. Upgrading from **Standard to Premium** * * Your remaining measurement period for the Standard plan will be refunded in credit form, to be applied automatically for your new Premium plan subscription. * Example) Billing changes when upgrading from Standard to Premium ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778314053401) 1\. Once the upgrading is initiated, your Standard plan subscription will be cancelled. If you had any remaining days under the Standard plan, the unused days will be refunded in the form of credit. * * * In this example, $92.80 has been refunded (for the unused 28 days, for 5 users). This resulted in a total credit balance of $54.24 based on previous bill history (which means that the previous credit balance was -$38.56) 2\. Premium plan subscription created immediately. * * * A new bill is created for 5 users with a charge of $200 ($40 x 5). This resulted in a total credit balance of -$145.76 ($54.24 - $200.00). Negative credit indicates that the user owes the amount to be paid. 3\. Payment completed, and Premium plan subscription started. 2\. Upgrading from **Free to paid plans** (Standard or Premium) * From [Console - Summary](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303236765721), click on 'Subscribe' ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778329034265) * From the [CLO-SET Pricing](https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing) page, select a plan to subscribe, and follow the [payment process.](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171146009) ### ⬇️ Downgrade (Unsubscribe) Downgrading will take place on your Group's **next renewal date**. Please note that CLO-SET does not refund the unused days of your monthly subscription once it is initiated. 1\. Downgrading from **Premium to Standard** * Important: Once your Group is downgraded to the Standard plan, there will be restrictions on the Group's usage. Please make sure to review the restrictions to minimize disruption. * Your existing Premium plan subscription will be valid until the end of your measurement period. On your next renewal date, your plan will be changed to Standard. * You **CANNOT** downgrade if your current usage exceeds the plan limit of the Standard plan. Please review your usage on '[Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257)' and make changes accordingly. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778329183129) | ![Pricing Page Modal.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778329308313) ---|--- 2\. Downgrading from **Premium/Standard to Free** * Downgrading will take place on your Group's next renewal date. Please note that CLO-SET does not refund the unused days of your monthly subscription once it is initiated. * If you had pending**negative credit balance** (to be paid) at the point of downgrading, you will be charged for the amount before your subscription is cancelled. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778329438361) * If you had pending**positive credit balance** at the point of downgrading, or failure of repurchasing, your credit will be 0 upon downgrading to free, and a billing history entry will be created. * For accounts that have already downgraded to Free before August 12, 2025, any existing positive credit will not be removed and remain) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778302557849) * You **CANNOT** downgrade if your current usage exceeds the plan limit of the Free plan. Please review your usage on '[Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257)' and make changes accordingly. ### 2) Refund Policy * Your subscription is valid until the end of Measurement Period, unless there was an upgrade attempt. * Please note that under [CLO-SET TOS](https://style.clo-set.com/policy/terms-of-service), no refunds are made for unused number of days in cash form, unless required by law. * For any inquiries, please [contact us](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).
content_description: This page provides step-by-step instructions on how to cancel your Advanced Plan subscription and downgrade to a free plan, along with important information regarding upgrades and the refund policy.

content: #### Permission: ![Admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778435945113) Admin ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778420616473) Collaborator ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778471293593) Editor # **Objective** ![web tech pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778436659225) | CLO-SET Web Tech Pack integrates your everyday tech pack with 3D Contents. Find more details on [Billing Guideline](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191886361) 4. **Charges** : Amount billed or paid per the event on description * Positive values (+): indicate paid amount OR credit that can be used for your next payment * Negative values (-): charged to the user to be paid in future 5. **Credit balance** : Remaining credit balance as a result of each event. * Positive values (+): credit that can be used for your next payment * Negative values (-): amount owed to be paid in future * from below image, 1️⃣ ➕ 2️⃣ 🟰 3️⃣ ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778941893529) * ### Invoice * Click on the Invoice no. to print or download your invoice. Please note that the 'To' field will display the user id and email of the account that first initiated the payment (either Group Admin or Group Operator account will be listed). * On the invoice, you can find the list of members that has been charged for the listed subscription period. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778942101913) ### 2) User History #### 1\. User Type Change * View the full list of changes on Group members that affects your subscription amount. * **For more information on permission by space, visit 'Permission Management' tab within Admin Console.** ![userhis.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778925775897) #### 3\. Email Change * View the list of users within the Group with the email change history. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778942837401) ### 3) Usage History ![Screenshot 2024-11-01 at 6.20.30 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778897328921) * View the Group's feature usage history per measurement period. * User/Company/Workroom is displayed as max count by period * File Upload/Rendering/Embed View/API Call is displayed as total count by period * For more details on how CLO-SET measures each field, visit [Feature Usage Measurement Criteria](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303208104857) * Depending on your group's subscribed plan, there may be restrictions on field usage. Trigger * Set Sync * Set Render Trigger * Set Webhook 2. API Token Article can be found HERE # **Details** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778973438361) ![developerpage.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778995119897) ## ### 1) Trigger ### [Set sync] 1\. Enter the URL and click 'Update' button. 2\. Go to style page. You can see the sync button activated. ![style_sync](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/common/images/style_sync.png) 3\. Click sync button to open new tab with the URL you entered above. The new tab's URL contains Style ID, style version, external style ID as query string. ### [Set Render trigger] 1\. Click 'ADD TRIGGER' under Render section. 2\. Choose workflow status that fires the trigger. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778990334233) 3\. Go to Workroom or Style page and change Workflow of style, and refresh your browser to initiate Render. _*Render will be requested with the uploaded file's render properties set in CLO S/W._ ![RenderTrigger.gif](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778990683545) #### Potential Error Cases in Render Trigger Fail * In any case where render cannot be completed, Render Trigger can not also be completed * When file has not completed parsing * When file has failed parsing * When Render Setting is not yet set * Render Setting has to be set in order for Render Trigger to properly work #### Render Properties of CLO3D * Rendering properties can be saved as .zvrp. It can also be opened in CLO3D. ![](https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/IJpthF2Vv7VzUy4yc_9eFfkmHoKt9mGB83E0llEuZq18sTsl6Sws7QhHweS9l3Ux89xpIoGrgnKp_SN-NFh3uzgU8YiZblRU3hBJrffftCsaSb0zIdCJCMUwDEwbU4t-l9SfRMJr4xFkjpxwq4FWzyA) | ![](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/L6yX0jT-bYhSn4XLtsB2jjmCHdIWMDMEF6EfqmzuD_3_9Q7DKTu_IWQdWfboncOiLVDUZ-6fTA6b5CcY5rILFTCGMpk2GjA9NTmPebmGuDc5xupldr__A_GA-DRYgXnk5lJ7uievTfgS_EXELt5Fxv0) ---|--- Render Properties of CLO3D When your Rendering Properties are established, you can then load the saved Rendering Properties without having to configure Rendering Properties every time. The loaded Rendering Properties will be saved as part of the .zprj file to be used in CLO-SET Trigger. ### [Set Webhook] #### 1\. Click 'Add trigger' under webhook section. 2\. Choose the trigger use case at which you want to fire the trigger. CLO-SET currently offers webhooks for 5 different use cases. \- Workflow: You can set a webhook to be fired at a specific Content Workflow. \- Invite / Share: You can set a webhook to be fired when a user has been invited/shared to a Space/Content. \- Content Upload: You can set a webhook to be fired when a Content is uploaded. \- Version Upload: You can set a webhook to be fired when a Version is uploaded. \- Colorway Status: You can set a webhook to be fired at a specific Colorway Status. 3\. Enter the URL that webhook will be requested. 4\. Enter the Name and Value if you want to check whether the request is valid. It will be added in HTTP header with webhook request. Webhook request body sample { "UpdateTime": "2020-07-21T06:25:09.759785Z", "UpdateUser": "hello@clo-set.com", "Topic": { "TopicId": "4ea0710a0e5f4e099d92f7a284d167f9", "Version": 1, "TopicType": 1 }, "TriggerType": 1, "TriggerOption": { "WorkflowSeq": 1679, "TriggerStatus": 1 } } Webhook body schema { "UpdateTime": { "$id": "#/properties/UpdateTime", "type": "string", "format": "date-time", "description": "The update time that trigger fired." }, "UpdateUser": { "$id": "#/properties/UpdateUser", "type": "string", "description": "Email address of user" }, "Topic": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic", "type": "object", "description": "The updated space/style information", "required": [ "TopicId", "Version", "TopicType" ], "properties": { "TopicId": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/TopicId", "type": "string", "description": "The id of updated style or space" }, "Version": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/Version", "type": "integer", "description": "Version of style. Will be '0' if topic type is not style.", "default": 0 }, "TopicType": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/TopicType", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "Enum for what the topic type is. 0 is none, 1 is style.", "default": "None" } } }, "TriggerType": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerType", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "The trigger type that webhook triggered. 0 is none, 1 is workflow", "default": 0 }, "TriggerOption": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption", "type": "object", "description": "The object information for trigger", "required": [ "WorkflowSeq", "TriggerStatus" ], "properties": { "WorkflowSeq": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption/properties/WorkflowSeq", "type": "integer", "description": "Workflow seq that tiggered." }, "TriggerStatus": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption/properties/TriggerStatus", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "The changed trigger status for triggered object. 0 is none, 1 is changed", "default": 0 } } } }

title: Billing Guideline
content: # **Objective** Understand how CLO-SET Group Pricing works, as well as invoices and billing. 1. Payment per Group 2. Automatic Renewal 3. Who is included in the bill? 4. Adding/Removing Users 5. What is Credit? 6. Refund 7. Example: Your Billing History Explained # **Details** ### 1\. Payment per Group * CLO-SET Pricing plan operates on a [**Group**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985) level. Subscribing to the Standard or Premium plan will be applied to all members within your Group. ### 2\. Automatic Renewal * Your subscription will be renewed every month. The monthly payment amount for your subscription may vary based on the number of users within your Group. * *All renewals are made on the same day your subscription started. As an exception, if you subscribed on the 31st, renewal will be done on the last day of every month (ex. on the months with 30 days only, your renewal will be on the 30th). ### 3\. Who is included in the bill? All users invited to or shared within the Group are included in the billing. This encompasses users with the following permissions: * Group Admin * Company Admin * Company Collaborator * Brand Admin * Brand Collaborator * Editor * Viewer **Note:** Users with only Group Operator permission are excluded from billing. Find out more on Permissions [HERE](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537). To view or manage your Group's permissions, please visit [Permission Management](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303195393049) tab. ### 4\. Adding/Removing users during your subscription You may need to add additional team members to your Group after your subscription has begun. * **Adding User:** Charged on the next billing cycle. Amount calculated on a daily basis. Each additional user will be charged for the # of days they were in the Group (ex. for Premium Plan: $40➗ # of days in month). * The amount will be recorded as Credit on your Group. Please see below for an example. * **Removing User** : If you delete a user during your billing cycle, the amount of unused days will be refunded in a form of Credit on your account (ex. for Premium Plan: $40 ➗ # of days in month). This additional Credit will automatically be used on your next payment. However, these addition credit cannot be transferred into cash refunds. Please see below for an example. * _Added users are billed from the day they have been added. Removed users are refunded including the day they have been removed._ _* All 'days' are counted based on the UTC timezone._ _* **Note:** The Active/Inactive status does not affect billing. It simply indicates whether a user is currently using the features. Even users marked as Inactive on the **User Activity** page are still considered paid users._ ### 5\. What is Credit? * Any changes on number of users within your Group will be reflected on your Group's Credit. All Credit Balance will be processed in your next payment. See below for examples. ### 6\. Refund * CLO-SET does not provide refunds for the subscription once it is initiated. Addition credits will be forfeited without cash refunds when downgrading to the Free plan. * Your credit balance will be retained when switching between Premium and Standard plans. ### 7\. Example: Your Billing History Explained ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777989667737) 1. **Subscription Created** : Billed for 5 users on the Premium Plan. 2. **Payment Complete** : Payment complete, subscription started for 5 users. 3. **Added 1 User to the Group:** The additional user will be billed as a prorated credit based on the number of days remaining until the renewal date. The accrued credit will be charged on the Group's next renewal date. * In this example, total credit billed is $33.10 * (Price per user / Total days in billing period) * Remaining days until renewal * ($40 / 29) * 24 = $33.10 * This amount is billed on your next renewal date. 4. **Removed 1 User from the Group:** The unused days for this member will be refunded as a credit and automatically applied to your next payment. * In this example, total credit refunded is $33.33 * (Price per user / Total days in billing period) * Remaining days until renewal * ($40 / 30) * 25 = $33.33 * This amount will automatically apply to your next payment. However, canceling your subscription (switching to the Free Plan) will forfeit this credit.
